scientific_integrity: The theorem is analytically proved with a finite exact-replay checker; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed bi-infinite strictly increasing grid only; real finite-total-variation data; Steffen knot derivatives; not variable-knot stability or arbitrary Hermite limiters. Historical priority has residual risk from inaccessible Steffen 1990 and 2013 nonuniform cubic Hermite full text. The May 8, 1992 archived reference date is a verified day of related literature, not the initial publication date of Steffen 1990.
title: Sharp mesh-ratio control of two-input variation for nonuniform Steffen cubic Hermite interpolation
